description: gzapi.ge's rules for fabric-pr arm. boundary.paths: the company site is a static Astro build deployed to a hosting account whose credentials a script in package.json downloads, so its boundary is the manifests and lockfiles that decide what installs and runs (package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, pnpm-workspace.yaml), the build and compiler configuration (astro.config.mjs, tsconfig.json, which load plugins and code at build time), the hosting configuration (wrangler config, _headers, _redirects), the harness wiring (.claude/: settings, hooks, commands), the ignore file that keeps .env out of a commit (.env*, .gitignore), CI (.github/), the site's source and static files (src/, public/: they are the code and markup the build ships to every visitor's browser, the owner, 2026-10-09), and words where the boundary is a file anywhere (secret, credential, token, key, auth). boundary.exempt is dropped first, but never under .claude/: Markdown prose and .agent-fabric/. No classes. waiver_role is null: only the owner waives the boundary.
